star hope who forged his way

1972, JP Derby.
The "Class of '47," one of history's best crops.
At the heart of a crowded Classic field,
three top horses struck fierce sparks:
the "Big Three." Now their pride collides.

The "Local Monster" can't be stopped.
Haiseiko keeps winning after moving to JRA.
Hopes swell & racing fever grows.
On big stage, monster unleashes his power.

1976, Satsuki Sho.
Kanto's ace, Tosho Boy "Sky Horse."
Kansai's hero, Ten Point "Shooting Star Prince."
Born same yr, rivals for crown,
they clash in first Classic.
日本がまだ世界の高い壁に苦しむさなか、\n突如現れた名血中の名血、マルゼンスキー:
While JP still struggled against world's high wall,
the bluest of blue bloods appeared: Maruzensky.
Fast enough to honor his pedigree,
he came to be called "Supercar."
Witness Supercar's dazzling driving.
短距離レースの地位が低かった時代に、率先して\nスプリント・マイル路線に進んだニ:
When sprints were looked down on, Nihon Pillow Winner
led way on sprint & mile route.
"Up to a mile, he's a match for Symboli Rudolf,"
they said. Now speedster comes alive.

"Seeking Pearl wins Maurice de Gheest"
JP fans rejoiced at first-ever feat.
Meanwhile a rumor spread across France:
"The JP horse coming next week is even stronger."
Mile king Taiki Shuttle now takes flight to world.
「最強世代」 いつしか彼らはそう呼ばれ始めた。\n「ターフを舞う怪鳥」エルコンド:
"The Strongest Gen." - so they came to be called.
El Condor Pasa, "the great bird soaring over turf."
Grass Wonder, "the Wonder Horse."
And Special Week, "the best sire's masterpiece."
Their exploits fired up JP racing.

The Opera King tore through the older main route.

2004, Arima Kinen.
A notice from a noble thief, his talent at last in bloom.
"One: autumn crown, Tenno Sho shield, is mine."
"Two: door abroad, JP's top spot, is mine."
"And tonight, I take Autumn Triple Crown."
２０２０年、菊花賞。\n３冠馬の仔には、常に重圧がのしかかる。ましてや、\nそれ:
2020, Kikuka Sho.
A Triple Crowner's son always feels weight,
all more with blue blood. Shrugging it off,
one horse chases an unbeaten Triple like his sire.
Time to draw a long, long contrail over Yodo.
世界の大レースで、日の丸を背負い戦う馬がいた。\nラヴズオンリーユー、愛の伝道師:

Loves Only You, messenger of love.
On US racing's special day,
the grand stage of Brdrs' Cup Day,
show the world's horsemen what you can do.

The girl who inherited her sire's stunning kick
strides toward Triple with a master aboard.
Having taken Oka & Oaks at will,
the "young lady" shows her class at Kyoto.

a true partnership of rider & horse
unleash their polished bond as one.
